items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever talk to Billy and Didi or any of the musicians who played at the Fillmore or any of those? What Billy?

ctx.x: He told the mule to open his mouth. He would stand up there with his lip hanging on and say, Why don't you open your mouth and quit licking at me?
Did you ever talk to the Preserv... Huh? Did you ever talk to Billy and Didi or any of the musicians who played at the Fillmore or any of those? What Billy?
The musicians, you ever talk to the guys at Preservation Hall, all the musicians, about all their travels when they go up to New York and...
